citation.locator: Appendix B.8, Factors for units listed alphabetically: 'acre (based on U.S. survey foot)', p. 45 (PDF p. 57); 'hectare (ha)', p. 50 (PDF p. 62); 'pound (avoirdupois) (lb)', p. 53 (PDF p. 65)

note: DERIVED from three printed factors: «acre (based on U.S. survey foot) ... square meter (m2) ... 4.046 873 E+03», «hectare (ha) ... square meter (m2) ... 1.0 E+04», «pound (avoirdupois) (lb) ... kilogram (kg) ... 4.535 924 E-01». 1 kg ha-1 = 4046.873 / 10000 / 0.4535924 lb acre-1 = 0.8921827 (rounded to 7 decimals). The acre printed is the one based on the U.S. survey foot; the difference from the international acre is below this precision. Converts residue mass (ratio x yield, kg ha-1) to the unit of the mass-cover coefficient (acre lb-1) of AH703 Table 5-1 (D129). Checked by the lead developer (gbarbozamar) in the session chat on 2026-11-15 against crops of the three lines (D34, D66). Identifier PROPOSED in brief #218.
